# State machines

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-state-machines.mjs from src/shared/stateMachines.json. Do not edit. -->

The source of truth is `src/shared/stateMachines.json`. The same registry writes the
TypeScript types in `src/shared/stateMachines.generated.ts`, the Rust enum in
`src-tauri/src/state_machine.rs`, and this page. A state may always stay where it is;
every other move must be one of the transitions below.

Run `node scripts/generate-state-machines.mjs` after editing the registry, and
`node scripts/generate-state-machines.mjs --check` to verify that everything is in step.

## Model server (`server`)

The life of the model server, from stopped to ready, busy, failed or unloaded. The Rust host and the Node sidecar both report these names.

Initial state: `stopped`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stopped` | Stopped | No server process is running. |
| `starting` | Starting | A server process was spawned and nothing is verified yet. |
| `loading` | Loading | The server answers, and the requested model is being warmed up. |
| `ready` | Ready | The model is served and can take a request. |
| `busy` | Generating | Reported while a completion is in flight; the internal server state stays ready. |
| `restarting` | Restarting | A failed or stopped server is launched again after an automatic retry. |
| `failed` | Failed | The server could not start, crashed, or lost its health. |
| `unloaded` | Unloaded | The server exited after its idle timeout; the next request loads it again. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stopped` | `start` | `starting` | A first start begins. |
| `stopped` | `failed` | `failed` | A start fails before a process is spawned, for example because the port belongs to another program. |
| `stopped` | `adopted` | `ready` | A compatible server that was already running answered a warm-up and was adopted. |
| `failed` | `adopted` | `ready` | A compatible server found after an earlier failure is adopted instead of starting another. |
| `unloaded` | `adopted` | `ready` | A compatible server found after an idle unload is adopted instead of loading another. |
| `stopped` | `restart` | `restarting` | A launch after at least one restart begins. |
| `unloaded` | `start` | `starting` | The next request loads the model again. |
| `failed` | `retry` | `starting` | The person starts again after a failure. |
| `failed` | `restart` | `restarting` | An automatic retry launches the server again. |
| `starting` | `served` | `loading` | The server answers and the model is proven to be served. |
| `starting` | `ready` | `ready` | Readiness is confirmed without a separate loading step. |
| `starting` | `failed` | `failed` | The process exits or never becomes healthy. |
| `loading` | `ready` | `ready` | Warm-up finishes. |
| `loading` | `failed` | `failed` | Warm-up fails or the process dies. |
| `ready` | `completion_started` | `busy` | A completion begins; this is the reported state, not the internal one. |
| `busy` | `completion_finished` | `ready` | The completion ends and the server is ready again. |
| `ready` | `idle_release` | `unloaded` | The runtime releases an idle model. |
| `ready` | `failed` | `failed` | The health watch finds the process gone. |
| `busy` | `failed` | `failed` | The process dies while a completion is in flight. |
| `restarting` | `ready` | `ready` | The retry succeeds. |
| `restarting` | `failed` | `failed` | The retry fails. |
| `stopped` | `stop` | `stopped` | A stop with nothing running changes nothing. |
| `starting` | `stop` | `stopped` | A start is cancelled. |
| `loading` | `stop` | `stopped` | A warm-up is cancelled. |
| `ready` | `stop` | `stopped` | The person stops the server. |
| `busy` | `stop` | `stopped` | The person stops the server during a completion. |
| `restarting` | `stop` | `stopped` | An automatic retry is cancelled. |
| `failed` | `stop` | `stopped` | A failed server is cleared. |
| `unloaded` | `stop` | `stopped` | An unloaded server is cleared. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `stopped` → `busy`
- `loading` → `starting`
- `busy` → `unloaded`
- `restarting` → `busy`

## Voice chat (`voice`)

One voice conversation: waiting, hearing speech, transcribing it, thinking, and speaking the answer.

Initial state: `idle`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | Idle | No voice session is open. |
| `listening` | Listening | The microphone is open and waiting for speech. |
| `hearing` | Hearing | Speech was detected and is being followed. |
| `transcribing` | Transcribing | The utterance ended and the recognizer is reading it. |
| `thinking` | Thinking | The words were sent and the answer has not started. |
| `speaking` | Speaking | The answer is being read aloud. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | `start` | `listening` | The voice chat opens. |
| `idle` | `read_aloud` | `speaking` | A message is read aloud without a voice session. |
| `listening` | `speech_started` | `hearing` | Sound above the level is heard. |
| `listening` | `reply_started` | `speaking` | A reply is read aloud while the microphone waits. |
| `listening` | `stop` | `idle` | The voice session closes. |
| `hearing` | `speech_discarded` | `listening` | The sound was not words; the microphone waits again. |
| `hearing` | `noise_while_held` | `speaking` | A held answer resumes after a noise. |
| `hearing` | `utterance_ended` | `transcribing` | The utterance ended; the recognizer reads it. |
| `hearing` | `stop` | `idle` | The voice session closes. |
| `transcribing` | `empty` | `listening` | The recognizer found no words. |
| `transcribing` | `text` | `thinking` | Words were recognized and sent. |
| `transcribing` | `self_heard` | `speaking` | The assistant heard its own voice and resumes speaking. |
| `transcribing` | `stop` | `idle` | The voice session closes. |
| `thinking` | `answer_ready` | `speaking` | The first sentence of the answer is read. |
| `thinking` | `answer_finished_mic` | `listening` | The answer ended with the microphone open. |
| `thinking` | `answer_finished_no_mic` | `idle` | The answer ended with no microphone. |
| `thinking` | `speech_interrupt` | `hearing` | A real interruption is being heard. |
| `speaking` | `speech_interrupt` | `hearing` | A real interruption holds the voice. |
| `speaking` | `answer_finished_mic` | `listening` | The answer ended with the microphone open. |
| `speaking` | `answer_finished_no_mic` | `idle` | The answer ended with no microphone. |
| `speaking` | `stop` | `idle` | The voice session closes. |
| `thinking` | `stop` | `idle` | The voice session closes. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `idle` → `hearing`
- `listening` → `thinking`
- `speaking` → `transcribing`
- `transcribing` → `hearing`

## File build (`build`)

The overall result of one build after its files and test run.

Initial state: `running`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `running` | Running | Files are being written or checked. |
| `done` | Done | Every file was written and the test run is clean. |
| `unresolved` | Unresolved | The files exist but the test run still shows a problem. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `running` | `finished` | `done` | The build ends clean. |
| `running` | `finished_with_problem` | `unresolved` | The build ends with a test run problem to look at. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `done` → `running`
- `unresolved` → `done`

## Harness run (`run`)

One multi-step run through the agent harness kernel: queued, running step by step, settling, and then done, unresolved, failed or cancelled. Every model-call pipeline of the app moves through these states.

Initial state: `queued`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | Queued | The run exists and no step has started. |
| `running` | Running | Steps are executing one at a time. |
| `settling` | Settling | The steps are finished and the outcome is being decided. |
| `done` | Done | Every step settled ok and the stop gate passed. |
| `unresolved` | Unresolved | The run ended with something unfinished: a retry budget spent, an interrupted step, a cancelled stop gate. |
| `failed` | Failed | A step failed hard (a final validator fault or an exhausted transport budget). |
| `cancelled` | Cancelled | The run was cancelled between steps. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | `start` | `running` | The first step begins. |
| `queued` | `cancel` | `cancelled` | The run was cancelled before any step started. |
| `running` | `steps_done` | `settling` | The plan's steps are finished (or a hard failure ended them) and the outcome is being decided. |
| `running` | `cancel` | `cancelled` | The run was cancelled between steps. |
| `settling` | `verdict_ok` | `done` | Every step settled ok and the stop gate passed. |
| `settling` | `verdict_problems` | `unresolved` | Something was left unfinished and the run names its first cause. |
| `settling` | `verdict_error` | `failed` | A step failed hard and the run names it. |
| `settling` | `cancel` | `cancelled` | The run was cancelled while settling. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `done` → `running`
- `failed` → `done`
- `unresolved` → `done`
- `cancelled` → `running`
- `done` → `settling`
- `queued` → `done`

## First-launch setup step (`setup`)

One component the first-launch setup installs: GenieX, llama.cpp, the dictation model or the read-aloud model. Each step moves on its own, so one failure never blocks the others.

Initial state: `pending`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pending` | Pending | The step is wanted and nothing has started. |
| `running` | Installing | The download or the installer is in progress. |
| `done` | Installed | The component is installed. |
| `error` | Failed | The install failed; the person can retry it. |
| `skipped` | Skipped | The person declined or skipped this component. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pending` | `start` | `running` | The step begins installing. |
| `running` | `installed` | `done` | The component was installed. |
| `running` | `failed` | `error` | The install failed. |
| `error` | `resume` | `running` | A later run picks the failed step up again. |
| `pending` | `skip` | `skipped` | The person declined or skipped the component. |
| `error` | `skip` | `skipped` | A failed component is given up on. |
| `done` | `skip` | `skipped` | An installed component is skipped (the screen lets a finished step be dismissed). |
| `pending` | `retry` | `pending` | Retry with the step already pending changes nothing. |
| `running` | `retry` | `pending` | The person asks to install this step again. |
| `error` | `retry` | `pending` | The person retries a failed step. |
| `skipped` | `retry` | `pending` | The person changes their mind about a skipped step. |
| `done` | `retry` | `pending` | The person asks to install a component again. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `done` → `running`
- `skipped` → `running`
- `done` → `error`
- `pending` → `done`

## Predictive model preload (`preload`)

The chat's preload of the model named in the composer: nothing wanted, warming, or warm and ready.

Initial state: `idle`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | Nothing wanted | No preload is wanted, or the last one ended. |
| `warming` | Warming | A preload request is in flight. |
| `ready` | Ready | The model is warm and can take a message. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | `trigger` | `warming` | The composer named a model that is not warm. |
| `idle` | `already_ready` | `ready` | The server already serves this model. |
| `warming` | `warmed` | `ready` | The preload request returned a warm model. |
| `warming` | `failed` | `idle` | The preload failed, or the composer was emptied. |
| `ready` | `retrigger` | `warming` | Another model was chosen and warming starts again. |
| `ready` | `idle_release` | `idle` | The composer stayed empty and the model was released. |

No forbidden jumps.

## Model benchmark run (`bench`)

One benchmark run, model by model: it prepares, installs, loads, warms the NPU, places the model, tests it and removes it, then rechecks the reference speed and ends done or stopped. Every phase the runner sets must be one the registry allows.

Initial state: `idle`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | Idle | No run is in progress. |
| `preparing` | Preparing | A model's turn begins: it is looked up and its result file is readied. |
| `installing` | Installing | The model file is being downloaded or installed. |
| `loading` | Loading | The model server is started and the model is loaded onto the NPU. |
| `warming` | Warming up | The biggest model writes without a pause, so later measurements are not on a cold chip. |
| `placing` | Placing | The runner judges from memory and activity whether the model runs on the NPU or the CPU. |
| `testing` | Testing | The fixed-workload speed track and the quality tests run. |
| `removing` | Removing | A model this run installed is uninstalled to free the space. |
| `rechecking` | Rechecking | At the end the reference model's speed is measured again, to show whether the NPU slowed down. |
| `done` | Done | The run reached the end of its list. |
| `stopped` | Stopped | The person stopped the run. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | `start` | `preparing` | The run begins and the first model's turn starts. |
| `preparing` | `to_installing` | `installing` | The model is not installed and is downloaded. |
| `preparing` | `to_loading` | `loading` | The model is already installed. |
| `preparing` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The turn ends early and this run's install is removed. |
| `preparing` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `preparing` | `next_model` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `preparing` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `preparing` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `installing` | `to_loading` | `loading` | The download finished; the server starts. |
| `installing` | `retry_provider` | `installing` | This provider's file failed; the next provider is downloaded. |
| `installing` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The install failed and what arrived is removed. |
| `installing` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `installing` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `installing` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `installing` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `loading` | `to_warming` | `warming` | The model loaded and the NPU warm-up begins. |
| `loading` | `to_installing` | `installing` | This provider's file would not load; the next provider is downloaded. |
| `loading` | `to_placing` | `placing` | The model loaded and no warm-up is wanted. |
| `loading` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The load failed and this run's install is removed. |
| `loading` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `loading` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `loading` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `loading` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `warming` | `to_placing` | `placing` | The warm-up is over; the placement check begins. |
| `warming` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The warm-up failed and this run's install is removed. |
| `warming` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `warming` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `warming` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `warming` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `placing` | `to_testing` | `testing` | The model is placed and the tests begin. |
| `placing` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The placement check ended and this run's install is removed. |
| `placing` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `placing` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `placing` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `placing` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `testing` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The tests are done and this run's install is removed. |
| `testing` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn ended here and the reference is rechecked. |
| `testing` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `testing` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `testing` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `removing` | `to_rechecking` | `rechecking` | The last turn removed its install and the reference is rechecked. |
| `removing` | `to_preparing` | `preparing` | The next model's turn starts. |
| `removing` | `to_done` | `done` | The run reaches the end of its list. |
| `removing` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |
| `rechecking` | `to_removing` | `removing` | The reference model this run installed is removed. |
| `rechecking` | `to_done` | `done` | The recheck is over and the run ends. |
| `rechecking` | `to_stopped` | `stopped` | The run was stopped. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `done` → `preparing`
- `done` → `rechecking`
- `stopped` → `preparing`
- `stopped` → `removing`
- `idle` → `done`
- `idle` → `removing`
- `idle` → `rechecking`
- `idle` → `testing`
- `installing` → `warming`
- `installing` → `testing`
- `rechecking` → `warming`
- `rechecking` → `preparing`

## Knowledge index (`knowledgeIndex`)

One project's knowledge index: queued, indexing, ready, stale when the files changed since it was built, or failed. The build in the store (src/core/knowledge/store.ts) drives the events — started by a request that needs it, and by the Files panel's add/remove, in the background; the Project knowledge screen shows the state it observes.

Initial state: `queued`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | Queued | The index does not exist yet; the first request that needs it — or the Files panel's add — builds it. |
| `indexing` | Indexing | The sections are being cut and the store is being written; the panel sees n of m. |
| `ready` | Ready | The index matches the files and retrieval reads from it. |
| `stale` | Stale | The project's files changed after the index was built; the next request — or the Files panel's change — rebuilds it. |
| `failed` | Failed | The build could not finish; the next request tries again, and the panel's Retry does the same. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queued` | `indexing` | `indexing` | A first build begins. |
| `ready` | `files_changed` | `stale` | The project's files changed after the index was built. |
| `stale` | `reindex` | `indexing` | The next request rebuilds the index over the changed files. |
| `failed` | `retry` | `indexing` | The next request tries the build again. |
| `indexing` | `restart` | `indexing` | A build that died mid-way (its tracker still says indexing) starts over. |
| `indexing` | `indexed` | `ready` | The sections were cut and the store was written (or works from memory). |
| `indexing` | `failed` | `failed` | The build could not finish; the error is named, not swallowed. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `queued` → `ready`
- `queued` → `stale`
- `ready` → `indexing`
- `failed` → `ready`
- `failed` → `stale`
- `stale` → `ready`

## Agent run (`agentRun`)

One Computer Use run against ONE target: either a single granted window (the sidecar loop observes, proposes, acts and verifies inside it) or a saved Word document edited as a copy (the Edit-a-copy loop reads it, proposes text edits, applies them to the copy and reopens the copy to verify). Either loop runs until the task is done, the person stops it, or a limit or failure settles it.

Initial state: `running`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `running` | Running | The loop is observing, proposing, acting or verifying — inside the granted window, or on the document copy. |
| `done` | Done | The model reported the task complete and every action it took was verified against the window, or the edited copy was verified against the source. |
| `unresolved` | Unresolved | The loop stopped without proving success: an action could not be verified, a step limit was reached, the model gave up after changes were already made, or the edited copy failed its verification. |
| `failed` | Failed | The run could not continue: the window disappeared, the driver died, or no usable proposal was produced. |
| `cancelled` | Cancelled | The person pressed stop; a person's stop settles cancelled, never failed. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `running` | `done` | `done` | The model said the task is complete and all actions verified. |
| `running` | `unresolved` | `unresolved` | Unverified actions, the step limit, or a give-up after changes settled the run. |
| `running` | `failed` | `failed` | The window, the driver or the model answer was lost. |
| `running` | `cancelled` | `cancelled` | The person stopped the run. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `done` → `running`
- `cancelled` → `running`
- `failed` → `running`
- `unresolved` → `running`
- `done` → `failed`
- `cancelled` → `failed`

## NPU owner (`npuOwner`)

Which engine holds the NPU: nobody, GenieX or Foundry Local. Concurrent engine ownership can crash the DSP. An engine takes the NPU only from nobody, so the other one is always released first.

Initial state: `free`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `free` | Free | No engine holds the NPU: a model of either engine may start. |
| `geniex` | GenieX | The GenieX model server holds the NPU. |
| `foundry` | Foundry Local | A Foundry Local model is loaded and holds the NPU. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `free` | `geniex_start` | `geniex` | A GenieX model starts on the free NPU. |
| `free` | `foundry_start` | `foundry` | A Foundry Local model loads on the free NPU. |
| `geniex` | `release` | `free` | The GenieX server is stopped before the other engine starts. |
| `foundry` | `release` | `free` | The Foundry Local model is unloaded and its service stopped before GenieX starts. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `geniex` → `foundry`
- `foundry` → `geniex`

## Model verdict on this PC (`modelVerdict`)

Whether an installed model loads here, the record the Models list reads (placements, loadFailures). A model is judged only on a load GenieX really attempted. Warm-up time alone does not establish a load failure.

Initial state: `unknown`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unknown` | Not checked | No load of this model was attempted on this PC with this runtime. |
| `checking` | Checking | Its load test is running. |
| `loads` | Loads | A load setting loaded it here (a placement is recorded). |
| `fails` | Does not load | No load setting loaded it, after GenieX really tried (a load failure is recorded with the reason and the runtime version). |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unknown` | `check` | `checking` | The startup check or the person starts its load test. |
| `checking` | `loaded` | `loads` | One load setting loaded it. |
| `checking` | `no_setting` | `fails` | GenieX tried every setting and none loaded it. |
| `checking` | `not_tried` | `unknown` | The test ended without GenieX trying (the app could not name the model, or the check was stopped): nothing is recorded. |
| `fails` | `runtime_changed` | `unknown` | Another GenieX version is installed: the old failure is dropped and the model is tried again. |
| `fails` | `loaded` | `loads` | A later load worked: the failure is cleared. |

Forbidden jumps (a shorter path is a bug):

- `unknown` → `fails`
- `unknown` → `loads`

## Computer Use window grant (`agentGrant`)

The host's single grant of a window to a Computer Use run. A failed start must release the grant so later runs can acquire it.

Initial state: `free`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `free` | Free | No window is granted: a run may begin. |
| `held` | Held | One window is granted to one run; another begin is refused. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `free` | `begin` | `held` | A run is granted the window the person picked. |
| `held` | `end` | `free` | The run ended, was stopped, failed to start, or the window died: the grant is released. |

No forbidden jumps.

## GenieX options probe (`geniexProbe`)

What the host knows of the installed GenieX's serve options, read from its own help. Partial help output must not be cached as a complete set of supported options.

Initial state: `not_probed`

| State | Name | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `not_probed` | Not probed | This GenieX executable was not asked yet. |
| `complete` | Complete | Its help named its own core options; the answer is kept for this executable. |
| `partial` | Partial | Its help came back without its core options; the answer is used once and never kept. |

| From | Event | To | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `not_probed` | `answered` | `complete` | The help names --model and --compute. |
| `not_probed` | `answered_in_part` | `partial` | The help is missing its core options (an update check, a slow first start). |
| `partial` | `answered` | `complete` | The next start asked again and got the whole help. |
| `partial` | `executable_changed` | `not_probed` | Another GenieX executable is installed. |
| `complete` | `executable_changed` | `not_probed` | Another GenieX executable is installed: it is asked again. |

No forbidden jumps.


## Every lifecycle in the program

This is the complete inventory the `scripts/lib/lifecycle-scan.mjs` scan looks after. Every
named state/status/phase/stage/step type, and every status/phase/worker union, found in the
source must appear here (as a migrated machine or as an inventory entry), and
`tests/state-machines.test.ts` fails when one does not. 33 lifecycles are listed:
13 migrated, 1 a real machine not migrated yet,
19 not a state machine.

### Migrated (13)

In `src/shared/stateMachines.json`; the generated types, the Rust enum and the tables above are their source of truth.

| Id | Title | Owner | User-visible | Where | How it is handled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `server` | Model server | Rust host, Node sidecar, renderer | yes | src-tauri/src/state_machine.rs; src/shared/stateMachines.json | Registered machine `server`. The generated Rust enum is the host's source of truth and the renderer reads the same names. |
| `voice` | Voice chat and the voice worker | core, renderer | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/renderer/voiceChat.ts; src/core/voiceService.ts | Registered machine `voice` for the conversation; the worker's own off/starting/ready/failed is covered by the same entry. |
| `build` | File build, its steps and its stages | core, renderer | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/core/build.ts | Registered machine `build` for the overall result; the step and stage statuses are its supporting labels. |
| `bench` | Model benchmark run | core, sidecar | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/core/benchRunner.ts:30 (`BenchPhase`) | Registered machine `bench`. The runner's every phase change in `set` goes through `canTransition('bench', …)`; the transitions were taken from the real paths, including the provider-retry loading → installing move. |
| `setup` | First-launch setup steps | core | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/core/setupView.ts:7 (`StepState`); src/core/setupService.ts | Registered machine `setup`. Each step's state change goes through `canTransition('setup', …)` in SetupService.set, so an impossible move is reported. |
| `run` | Harness run | core | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/core/harness/run.ts (`RunState`) | Registered machine `run`. Every createRun moves through nextState('run', ...) per step and at the outcome; an illegal move is logged, never a crash mid-run. A journal step's status is a record label of the same machine, and the run view sent to the screen (phase 11) carries the same labels, read-only. |
| `knowledgeIndex` | Knowledge index of one project | sidecar, renderer | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/core/knowledge/store.ts (the build drives the events); src/renderer/Projects.tsx (the observed state) | Registered machine `knowledgeIndex`. The store's build goes through the machine's events; the Project knowledge screen shows the state observed from the store. |
| `agentRun` | Computer Use agent run | sidecar, renderer | yes | src/shared/stateMachines.json; src/sidecar/computerUse.ts (the loop settles it, settle is the only writer of the final status); src/renderer/AgentPanel.tsx (the observed state) | Registered machine `agentRun` for the run's verdict (running, done, unresolved, failed, cancelled). The step phases (observe, propose, act, verify, settled) are supporting labels the events carry, read-only — the person's stop settles cancelled, never failed. |

The controller's phase change goes through `canTransition('preload', …)` (a null phase is the machine's idle state), so an impossible move is reported. |
